headline: Yermak probe framed as a test for Ukraine and a dilemma for Zelensky
summary: Western coverage casts the case as a test of Ukraine's anti-corruption institutions — the same ones Zelensky tried to subordinate via Law 12414 last summer before protests forced a repeal.

headline: Yermak taken into pre-trial detention after three-day hearing
summary: After a three-day hearing in Kyiv, Yermak is detained on money-laundering charges; he says he cannot pay the ~$3.2M bail.

headline: While under NABU suspicion, Yermak co-founds law firm 'Edvox' in Vinnytsia

headline: Maduro back in US court for pretrial hearing, possible June 2027 trial date
